title: Cold rebuild: Chunked
summary: Rebuild Chunked from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Chunked** in *Generators and yield*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.explain: Nothing in the body runs until the first `next`. Each `next` runs to the following `yield`. `end` never prints because nobody asked for a third value.

steps.title: Rebuild Chunked cold
prompt: Write a generator `chunks(items, size)` that yields lists of `size` consecutive items; the last chunk may be shorter. It must work on **any iterable**, including another generator, so do not use `len` or slicing on `items`.
Raise `ValueError` if `size < 1` (raising happens on first use, that is fine).
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
